query.policy: An order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action. In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.

answer.rephrased: An order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered'. Before taking the action, you must check the status of the order. Additionally, you must remind the customer to confirm that they have provided all the items that are to be exchanged.
